Multiverse Computing, a European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator awardee, announced a strategic partnership with Axelera AI during its appearances at GITEX Global and CES. The collaboration aims to combine Multiverse's high‑performance computing platform with Axelera's AI technologies to accelerate industrial‑scale AI workloads. The alliance aligns with the EU’s objectives to foster innovation and strengthen multinational technology partnerships.
